clue.text: Where horses are given a drink in London

definitions.text: Where horses are given a drink in London

parts.words: Where horses are given a drink in London
parts.note: bay horses are bays, and to give them a drink is to water them, so a place for that would be named for both: a London district

explanation.surface: A question about where London's horses get watered.
explanation.walkthrough: BAYSWATER is a district of west London; split as BAYS (brown horses) + WATER (give a drink), the clue reads it literally.
explanation.definitionFit: Bayswater is a residential area of west London near Hyde Park, the place the clue's literal reading points to.

clue.text: A person lacking experience fibs for friends

parts.note: L stands for learner, as on a learner driver's plate
fibs are lies

explanation.surface: A novice tells fibs to get friends.
explanation.definitionFit: Allies are partners or supporters on the same side, so friends in a broad sense.

clue.text: An engineer's papers set in order

indicators.note: to set papers in order is to rearrange them, so the letters of the word are reordered

explanation.surface: An engineer tidies their paperwork.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', joining the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A sapper is a military engineer, one who digs trenches and builds fortifications.

clue.text: A few had debts, it's maintained

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held 'A few had debts, it's maintained (6)': wordplay needs A + V (five, Roman numeral) + OWED; 'few' gives no V, and no scan or search confirms the printed word.
annotationWithheld.clue: A few had debts, it's maintained

clue.text: This has a bad effect on the listeners

definitions.text: This has a bad effect on the listeners

parts.words: This has a bad effect on the listeners
parts.note: listeners reads as an audience but means the ears themselves, and something bad affecting them is a pain there

explanation.surface: Something that spoils things for an audience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Listeners' suggests people hearing a broadcast; here it is the ears.
explanation.definitionFit: Pain in the ear is a bad effect felt by the organs of hearing.

clue.text: The German marking birds for the gun

parts.note: der is the German masculine word for 'the'
one who rings birds, fitting identification bands to their legs, is a ringer

explanation.surface: A German man tagging birds in exchange for a firearm.
explanation.definitionFit: A derringer is a small pocket pistol, a type of handgun.

clue.text: A head for capital investment?

definitions.meaning: the head of a school or college
the capital sum invested or lent, as opposed to the interest

explanation.surface: Asking for a leader to run a capital investment.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a school head and the original sum of money invested.

clue.text: Alien admitting cash could make him an assassin

indicators.note: admitting means letting in, so one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: an alien is a stranger
L is the abbreviation for pound, a unit of cash

explanation.surface: A foreigner who takes money could turn into a hired killer.
explanation.definitionFit: A strangler kills by throttling, a killer of the kind the clue calls an assassin.

clue.text: Group takes bible studies in private

indicators.note: a group that takes something holds it within itself, so one piece goes inside

parts.note: a sect is a religious group
RE is religious education, school bible studies

explanation.surface: A religious group studies scripture behind closed doors.
explanation.definitionFit: Something secret is kept private, hidden from others.

clue.text: Applaud the directors facing the house?

parts.note: to applaud is to clap
the directors of a company form its board

explanation.surface: Theatre audience cheering the producers in front of the auditorium.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Facing' means a covering on the front, and 'the house' suggests a theatre audience but is a building.
explanation.definitionFit: Clapboard is overlapping timber cladding fixed to the outside walls of a building.

clue.text: Design in underwear for a woman

indicators.note: one piece is placed in the other

parts.note: a bra is an item of underwear
design in the sense of purpose or aim is an end

explanation.surface: A pattern on lingerie made for a lady.
explanation.definitionFit: Brenda is a female first name, so a woman in crossword terms.

clue.text: Mention the source of information

definitions.meaning: to make ... to something is to mention it
a cited work or book consulted for facts

explanation.surface: Citing where a fact comes from.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both an allusion in speech and a cited authority or reference book.

clue.text: The finale is killing!

definitions.meaning: the finale is the last part of a show or story

explanation.surface: A theatre-goer raves that the final act is hilarious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Killing' suggests 'very funny' but means putting an end to something.
explanation.definitionFit: An ending is a conclusion, and ending something is also terminating it.

clue.text: Withdrew with only slight damage done

definitions.meaning: a horse or competitor ... is withdrawn from a race
something ... has a superficial mark on its surface

explanation.surface: Someone backed out of an event having suffered only minor harm.
explanation.definitionFit: To be scratched is both to be pulled from a contest and to be lightly marked.

clue.text: Body building, cuts beans out

indicators.note: building suggests putting together, so the letters are assembled anew

parts.note: taken as written as the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A bodybuilder trims beans from the diet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Body building' reads as one phrase; 'Body' is the definition and 'building' the anagram signal, with 'out' as a second signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Body in the sense of solidity or weight, as in a wine with body, is substance.

clue.text: Property of taste in the main

definitions.text: Property of taste in the main

parts.words: Property of taste in the main
parts.note: in the main reads as 'mostly' but means in the sea, whose water has this distinctive flavour

explanation.surface: A remark on what mostly defines flavour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the main' looks like 'generally' but 'the main' is an old word for the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Seawater's salt content gives it a briny taste, the property named.

clue.text: A portion of toast each for a light meal

indicators.note: a portion of the words means a run of letters taken from inside them

explanation.surface: A slice of toast each makes a snack.
explanation.definitionFit: Tea in Britain can be a light afternoon meal of sandwiches and cakes.

clue.text: A number may appear cross

parts.note: cross suggests annoyed but means the shape of a cross, the Roman numeral X

explanation.surface: Someone notes that a number of people may look angry.
explanation.walkthrough: The Roman numeral X looks like a cross.
explanation.definitionFit: Ten is written X in Roman numerals, a cross shape.

clue.text: Fit for a little exercise

parts.note: PT is physical training, shortened

explanation.surface: Getting fit through a bit of a workout.
explanation.definitionFit: Apt means suitable, as does fit.

clue.text: Firm article in press showing boldness

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm

indicators.note: one piece is placed in the other

parts.note: to press someone is to urge them
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A company's newspaper piece demonstrates daring.
explanation.definitionFit: Courage means bravery, a synonym of boldness.

clue.text: Tapered fashions are older

indicators.note: to fashion is to shape, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: Tapered styles are dated.
explanation.definitionFit: To predate something is to come before it, so being older than it.

clue.text: 17 down returned when clear of all charges

indicators.note: returned means sent back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: the answer to 17 down is the number ten

explanation.surface: A cross-reference that reads like a court acquittal.
explanation.definitionFit: Net means after all deductions, with charges taken off.

clue.text: Conservation is a Government priority

parts.note: conservation suggests environmentalism but means saving resources, a state's careful management of money

explanation.surface: A green policy statement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Conservation' suggests nature, but here it means thrift.
explanation.definitionFit: Economy is thrift, careful saving of resources, and also a government's management of finances.

clue.text: Fool accepting place just for the money

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: an ass is a fool
to place something is to set it

explanation.surface: A fool taking a job only for the pay.
explanation.definitionFit: Assets are resources of value such as cash and property, so the money one holds.

clue.text: A Pole's somewhat odd leaning

indicators.note: something odd is out of the ordinary, so the letters are put out of order

parts.note: the letters of the word with its s

explanation.surface: A Polish person's rather strange inclination.
explanation.definitionFit: Aslope means sloping, tilted, so leaning.

clue.text: Little angel fish named without hesitation

indicators.note: without in the old sense of outside, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: the chub is a freshwater fish
er is a sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: An angelfish named confidently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Angel fish' reads as one creature; 'Little angel' is the definition and 'fish' the next piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A cherub is a winged child angel in art.

clue.text: Many an also-ran could be better-matched

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, many
an also-ran is one who did not win, a loser

explanation.surface: A remark that many runners-up might be more evenly matched.
explanation.definitionFit: Closer describes a contest whose sides are nearer in standard, more evenly matched.

clue.text: A little beast's retreat in Cornwall

definitions.meaning: a small rodent's bolt-hole in a skirting board
a fishing village on the Cornish coast near Penzance bears this name

explanation.surface: A small animal hiding in the far south-west of England.
explanation.walkthrough: Mousehole is a fishing village in Cornwall, the south-western tip of England; literally it is a hole for a mouse.
explanation.definitionFit: A Cornish village shares its name with a rodent's hiding place in a wall.

clue.text: Call about a girl, making a crack

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: a call is a cry
Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Phoning about a young woman results in a joke.
explanation.definitionFit: A cranny is a narrow opening or chink, a crack.

clue.text: Flusters or cuts oil painter

indicators.note: to fluster is to agitate, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: An artist is unsettled, either by cutting or by oil.
explanation.definitionFit: A colourist is an artist noted for skilful use of colour.

clue.text: Release from cold employment

parts.note: ex means from, as in goods sold ex works
C is the abbreviation for cold on taps
employment of something is its use

explanation.surface: Freedom from a chilly job.
explanation.definitionFit: To excuse someone from a duty is to release them from it.

clue.text: Buyers lay off the duck

indicators.note: off means gone wrong, so the letters are muddled

explanation.surface: Shoppers stop laying, so the duck goes.
explanation.definitionFit: The Aylesbury is a breed of white domestic duck from Buckinghamshire.
